name: Email OAuth2 Proxy UI
description: Lightweight Go Web UI for managing an existing Email OAuth2 Proxy installation on Runtipi. Provides 1-click OAuth authentication, external client OAuth monitoring, real-time port probing, provider presets, TLS/CA certificate generation, Docker port management, config editor, and live log streaming.
short_desc: Web UI manager for Email OAuth2 Proxy on Runtipi
author: MurkBRA

form_fields.label: PROXY_STORE_ID
form_fields.hint: Store subfolder where email-oauth2-proxy is installed under app-data/ and user-config/ (e.g. migrated for migrated apps, or runtipi for a fresh official store install). Default: migrated.

form_fields.label: PROXY_HOST
form_fields.hint: Hostname or service name of Email OAuth2 Proxy on Runtipi's Docker network (tipi_main_network). Default: email-oauth2-proxy.

form_fields.label: PROXY_CONTAINER
form_fields.hint: Exact Docker container name of Email OAuth2 Proxy used for restarts, Debug Mode toggle (SIGUSR1), and port management. Default: email-oauth2-proxy.

form_fields.label: ADMIN_USER
form_fields.hint: Username for Web UI login (used only when ADMIN_PASSWORD is set). Default: admin.

form_fields.label: ADMIN_PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: Set a password to protect the Web UI with session login. Leave blank to keep authentication disabled.
